reason: The CIFs parse, symmetry-expand to full-occupancy Li4Nb2O2F10 (18 atoms; primitive Li2NbOF5), and share the strongly indexed C2 cell (39/39 selected lines), but the atomic realization is not established. Direct whole-profile tests of the instantiated CIFs give normalized residuals of about 0.217 and 0.245 versus about 0.067 when the same indexed reflections have free intensities; major lines near 28.04, 28.17, and 53.43 degrees have 10-16%-of-maximum integrated-intensity errors, far above the approximately 0.10-intensity baseline noise. The trace itself acknowledges substantial profile mismatch, derives coordinates through chemistry-penalized searches rather than a converged coordinate refinement, and identifies a near-degenerate alternative Li minimum that is not represented: both submitted CIFs have exactly the same Li site despite the final claim that this ambiguity was covered. Both also contain a full-occupancy 1.80 angstrom Li-Li periodic contact. Thus the cell is solved, but ordering/coordinates and periodic chemistry remain dubious enough that another attempt can materially improve or replace the submitted realizations.
